dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: If you ask me, everyone should watch a show at Zubayr Theater!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Zubayr Theater...

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: In the Grand Bazaar of Sumeru City, there is Zubayr Theater, full of song and dance.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: The manager Sheikh Zubayr is a real genius! He knows playwriting and choreography, and even makes props. He excels in everything!

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: The beautiful dancer Nilou performs even better than ever with the choreography of Sheikh Zubayr.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: You may consider yourself lucky if you ever get to see her dance at the Sabzeruz Festival!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: I'm just the most ordinary traveling scholar at the Akademiya. I'm nobody.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: If I had a gift for art, I probably wouldn't have gone to the Akademiya. Just a joke, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: There seems to be very few people at the Akademiya who have a thing for singing and dancing. Perhaps research and papers take up most of their time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Make sure you see Nilou's dance performance at Grand Bazaar!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Sabzeruz Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: Sabzeruz Festival is the festival celebrating the birthday of Sumeru's deity — the Dendro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: After Greater Lord Rukkhadevata passed away, Sabzeruz Festival was moved to the birthday of Lesser Lord Kusanali. Unfortunately, the festival lost some of its former glory in the process...

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: The Akademiya no longer hosts the festival, and we practically have little chance to see the Dance of Sabzeruz.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: What a pity...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Sabzeruz Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: The Sabzeruz Festival is the festival celebrating the birthday of Sumeru's deity — the Dendro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: It is said that in the ancient past, the Goddess of Flowers would dance at the Dendro Archon's birthday, and the Padisarahs would bloom across the stage...

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: Thus, we call the Dendro Archon's birthday celebration the "Sabzeruz Festival."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Studying is important.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: True. With knowledge, you can live a better life.

dialogues.speaker: Parisa
dialogues.text: But we shouldn't be rigid in our studies. Only with a flexible mind can we unravel greater mysteries.
